title: 書架、卷軸與閱讀回饋
scope: source implementation and local verification; not production acceptance
criteria: 原創 CSS 書架／封蠟／書籤，與 #79 的木色、紫暮、金色語言相容
只有已符合條件的書籤與 Cloud opened metadata 影響閱讀回饋，不製造活動／XP
360px 無水平溢出；原生連結、表單與按鈕，鍵盤／跳至內容可用
八頁 axe WCAG A／AA 零違規、減少動態有相同操作；沒有 Canvas-only 操作
limitations: 需要入口切片先提供 HTML 與基礎樣式；小鎮整體視覺／真人輔具與實機手機尚待整合驗收。
ci: exact head six checks required; final status in PR
browser_transport: Auth/Firestore loopback emulators, SDK 9.22.0, test attested-handler adapter. Actual shared bootstrap smoke also passed; no production network in that smoke.

browser_checks.axe: zero WCAG A/AA violations on eight pages
browser_checks.transport: loopback Auth/Firestore emulators and attested-handler adapter, not production App Check
